title: Corebridge Financial, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Corebridge Financial filed an 8-K on April 14, 2026 announcing the election of Hirotaka Inoue as a director, effective April 21, 2026, replacing Minoru Kimura who resigned. The board composition change stems from Nippon Life Insurance's board designation rights under a December 2024 stockholder agreement. AIG waived its right to designate any board members, and the board was reduced from 13 to 11 members.
key_points: Hirotaka Inoue elected to Corebridge Financial Board on April 14, 2026, effective April 21, 2026
Replaces Minoru Kimura who resigns April 20, 2026 as a Nippon Life Designee
Board size reduced from 13 to 11 members effective March 25, 2026
AIG waived its right to designate board members under the Separation Agreement on March 23, 2026
Nippon Life granted waiver to maintain three designees instead of two based on reduced board size
Mr. Inoue qualifies as independent under NYSE Corporate Governance Standards
